# Alok Das (alokdasofficial)

> Chemistry Graduate & Scientific Software Builder
> Assam, India • M.Sc. Chemistry (Rabindranath Tagore University) • Developer of Alomole, Mileage Tracker, and Interactive Lab Simulators.

## Overview
Alok Das is a chemistry researcher and scientific software developer based in Assam, India. He holds a Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Chemistry with Distinction and is currently pursuing his Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Chemistry at Rabindranath Tagore University (Hojai, Assam). 

His primary expertise spans analytical chemistry, phytochemical screening, chromatographic separation (TLC), and quality control (QC/GLP) protocols. Concurrently, he designs and develops production-grade cross-platform mobile apps using Flutter and responsive web applications utilizing Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## Primary Specializations & Skills
### Scientific & Laboratory
- Analytical Chemistry: Volumetric, gravimetric, spectrophotometric analysis, Beer-Lambert verification.
- Phytochemical Screening: Extraction and secondary metabolite identification (alkaloids, flavonoids, saponins, tannins) from regional flora.
- Chromatography: Thin Layer Chromatography (TLC), Rf value calculation, solvent system optimization.
- Laboratory Practice: Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), standard solutions preparation, lab safety, equipment calibration.

### Software Engineering
- Mobile Development: Flutter (Dart), State Management (Provider, Riverpod), SQLite, Offline-first architectures, Google Play Store publication.
- Web Development: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Schema.org JSON-LD, SEO/AEO/GEO optimization.
- Scientific Computing: Interactive chemistry simulators, molecular weight calculators, stoichiometry engines.

## Key Projects & Published Applications
- **Alomole**: Molecular calculator and chemistry companion app designed for students and lab analysts to calculate molar masses, elemental percentages, and reaction stoichiometry.
- **Mileage Tracker**: Production Android utility on Google Play for recording vehicle fuel efficiency, expenses, and trip telemetry with local-first offline storage.
- **Interactive Science Labs**: Browser-based laboratory simulations built into alokdasofficial.in, including:
  - Acid-Base Titration Simulator (dynamic pH curve calculation)
  - Beer-Lambert Law Simulator (absorbance vs. concentration calibration)
  - Reaction Kinetics & Arrhenius Equation Modeling
  - pH Scale & Ionic Product Visualizer
  - Refraction & Snell's Law Optics Tool
  - Ohm's Law & Circuit Analysis Simulator
  - Measurement & Significant Figures Mastery Tool
